name: Itadaki Joshi, Itadakimasu ~Papakatsu Joshi Korashime Keikaku~
original_name: 頂き女子、いただきます ～パパ活女子懲らしめ計画～
source:
A few years ago, a woman deceived me and turned my life upside down.
She led me to believe we’d get married, so I broke up with my girlfriend at the time and was even prepared to devote my entire life to her. Thanks to her, my life is now a complete mess.

“Kirari-chan, the Predatory Girl”
Apparently, the woman who deceived me has been operating under that name lately.
Not content with just me, she’s targeting the next vulnerable man… I can’t forgive her. I won’t let her create another victim like me ever again.

Staring at her new account, I made a vow.
I’ll make this woman, who makes a living by deceiving others, understand exactly what she’s done—and this time, I’ll turn her life upside down.
